Task: Return a segmentation-mask surrogate image for chest radiograph pneumothorax segmentation.
Target: pneumothorax
Clinical context: This is a chest radiograph. Segment pleural air (pneumothorax): a peripheral region with absent lung markings beyond the visceral pleural line between collapsed lung and chest wall or mediastinum.
Output requirements:
1) Output image dimensions must exactly match input dimensions.
2) Two colors only: background exactly #00FF00 and ROI exactly #FFFFFF.
3) No text, no overlays, no transparency, no gradients, no blur, no antialiasing.
4) Return only the mask surrogate image.
Exclusions (negative constraints): do not include normal lung parenchyma, mediastinum/heart, ribs, clavicles, scapulae, skin folds, chest tubes, external labels/lines/overlays, or scanner annotations.
Low-contrast constraint: avoid scattered micro-islands; prefer one contiguous ROI when clinically plausible.
Minimum ROI area fraction: 0.0
Maximum ROI area fraction: 0.8
Minimum connected components: 1
Maximum connected components: 1024
Tool mode: text + image grounding enabled. Use retrieval for reasoning only; output must remain original mask surrogate pixels.
NanoBanana image-generation mode: return one generated image only, with no markdown, JSON, or explanatory text.
